reopenings.owner_statement: The seeker with cloak (frist row) the animationisn't walking, jsut rocking a bit. The legs never cross

front and back views are acceptable, side views are not - the straight legs  are angled backwards. Either a staight leg gait scissoring from a central pelvic point, or a true natural gait with knee flexion/extension

Much improved, but still a problem. The thighs are offset backwards in the pelvis, there is this sharp frontal edge where something is missing. Imagine a pivot point im the middle of the pelvis, where the thighs can move back and forth, and another pivot point in the knee, where the lower leg can only bend and straighten. Thighs back and forward, scissoring. Knees straight and bend backwards only.

Much improved again, but still a little unnatural. Important: during a gait phas, the front knee moves from well behind the former front knee to fell in fornt of it, and the former fron knee does the opposite, and the former front foot becomes the hind foot.  In your animation, one foot always stays behind.
Exactly. Please implement and show me the results
